title: Cut the oil, leak the secrets, feed the people: Trump's blueprint to break Cuba
text:
In the realm of modern geopolitics, a secret is rarely exposed by accident. When granular details of classified American operations suddenly flood national headlines, it is almost always the result of a deliberate, calculated leak designed to serve as a weapon of psychological warfare. This is the exact playbook the Trump administration is currently deploying just 90 miles off the coast of Florida.

While the legacy press remains utterly transfixed by the geopolitical aftershocks in Eastern Europe, Washington has quietly initiated a highly sophisticated gray-zone campaign aimed at forcing the total collapse of the 67-year-old Cuban communist regime. By masterfully orchestrating a two-track strategy of total infrastructure denial and deep-cover backchannel diplomacy, the administration is using weaponized media disclosures to shatter Havana’s operational security from the inside out.
